title: In the scorer's own layout, R-017's published text already meets the scribe target at p = 0.015 and the dialect version at p = 0.005
statement: Check of P-G-009 against the text already on the record, before the fact is registered. I laid R-017's published lines and first_lines (experiments/R-attack-F-018/fleet-fable/attack.json) onto the practice evaluation pages exactly as the scorer does for a fact attack (vs/redteam.py, cut lines) and computed P-G-009's statistic on the result and on the manuscript: cosine of raw word counts for every pair of pages with at least 40 certain paragraph words, median over same-label pairs minus median over different-label pairs, against the labels dealt at random among whole pages (399 deals). Hand labels (Davis, from the transliteration header), 31 pages: manuscript 0.106 (p = 0.0025; the same value P-G-009 reports, so the statistic matches), R-017 text 0.071 (p = 0.015). Currier language labels, 29 pages: manuscript 0.122 (p = 0.0025), R-017 text 0.111 (p = 0.005). So the drifting chain is not far from this target in the format the scorer actually uses: registered at alpha 0.05 the scribe fact would fall to the existing R-017 text at once, at alpha 0.01 it would stand against that text by a narrow margin, and the dialect version would fall at either level. The difference from P-G-009's 0 of 15 is probably the layout: laid end to end onto 34 sampled pages, the chain's drift over the 20-page public window follows the manuscript order, and hand and language come in runs along that order on the sampled pages as well, so neighbouring sampled pages of one hand receive text from similar windows. This agrees with fleet-fable's own observation in P-G-007 that the contiguous layout lets local memory reach across sampled pages. Recommendation: register the scribe fact at alpha 0.01, state in its source that R-017's text gives p = 0.015 in the scorer's layout, and test it against fresh drifting-chain texts in that layout (and in P-G-007's whole-book sampled form) before calling it a fact the chain cannot copy; and prefer fixing the attack layout (P-G-007) before registering more long-range facts.
check: Lay experiments/R-attack-F-018/fleet-fable/attack.json onto the practice evaluation pages with vs/redteam.py (cut lines) and compute the same-label minus different-label median page cosine for hand and for Currier language, with labels dealt among whole pages.
